spans.s:
अश्र 1. अश्र, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. अश्, wrongly
spelt अस्र), a corner [cf. अश्रि].
अश्र 2. अश्र, अम्, n. = अश्रु, a tear, q. v.

अश्र 3. अश्र, अम्, n. = अस्र, blood, q. v.
—अश्र-प, अस्, m. fiend, a cannibal, ‘a blood-drinker.’

अस्र अस्र, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 2. अस्), hair
of the head; a corner, an angle, see अश्र; (अम्),
n. blood; a tear, see असृज् and असन्.
—अस्र-
कण्ठ, अस्, m. an arrow; (perhaps a variation from
अस्त्र-कण्ठ ?).
—अस्र-खदिर, अस्, m. a red Mi-
mosa.
—अस्र-ज, अम्, n. flesh.
—अस्र-जित्, त्, m. a
plant; see अस्त्र-जित्.
—अस्र-प, अस्, m. a Rākṣasa
or goblin; (आ), f. a leech; a Dākinī or female imp.
—अस्र-पत्त्रक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, Rubia
Cordifolia L. (?).
—अस्र-पित्त, अम्, n. plethora,
hemorrhage, epistaxis, involuntary discharge of blood
from the mouth, nostrils, anus, &c.
—अस्र-फला, f.
the plant Boswellia Thurifera Roxb.
—अस्र-मातृका,
f. chyle, chyme.
—अस्र-रोधिनी, f. the plant Mi-
mosa Pudica.
—अस्र-विन्दु-च्छदा, f., N. of a tu-
berous plant.
—अस्रार्जक (˚र-अर्˚), अस्, m. the
white Tulasī plant.
अश्राय, nom. A. अश्रायते, -यितुम्, to shed tears.
अस्राय, nom. A. अस्रायते, -यितुम्, to shed tears.

आ-श्रय, अस्, m. that to which anything is annexed,
or with which anything is closely connected, or on
which anything depends or rests; a recipient, the per-
son or thing in which any quality or article is inherent
or retained or received; seat, resting-place; dwelling,
asylum, place of refuge, shelter; depending on, having
recourse to; help, assistance, protection; authority,
sanction, warrant; a plea, an excuse; being inclined
or addicted to, following, practising; attaching to,
choosing, taking; joining, union, attachment; de-
pendance, contiguity, vicinity; relation; connection;
appropriate act or one consistent with the character
of the agent; (in gram.) the subject, that to which
the predicate is annexed; (with Buddhists) the five
organs of sense with मनस् or mind (the six together
being the recipients of the आश्रित or objects which enter
them by way of their आलम्बन or qualities); source,
origin. आश्रय may occur at the end of compounds
in the sense of ‘depending on, resting on, endowed
or furnished with’ (e. g. अष्ट-गुणाश्रय, see under
अष्ट).
—आश्रय-तस्, ind. in consequence of the
proximity.
—आश्रय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of आ-श्रय
above.
—आश्रय-भुज्, क्, m. fire; see आश्रयाश.
—आश्रय-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who is the refuge
[]
or support of another person, protecting, supporting.
—आश्रय-लिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, a word the gender of
which must agree with the gender of the word to
which it is referred, an adjective.
—आश्रय-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having help or support.
—आश्रयाश (˚य-
आश), अस्, आ, अम्, consuming everything with which
(it) comes in contact; (अस्), m. fire; a forfeiter of
an asylum, one who by misconduct &c. loses patronage
or protection.
अश्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having tears, in tears.
अश्रिन् अश्रिन्. See under 2. अश्र.

अ-श्राद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, not performing funeral
rites, not entitled to them, not belonging or relating
to them; (अस्), m. non-performance of funeral rites.
—अ-श्राद्ध-भोजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has taken
the vow not to eat during the performance of the
Śrāddha ceremonies.

अ-श्रद्दधान, अस्, आ, अम्, unbelieving, incre-
dulous, having no faith.

अ-श्रद्धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be believed, in-
credible.

अस्राम अ-स्राम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not stiff,
not lame.
अ-स्राम; add — not withered (Ved.).

आश्रम आ-श्रम, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. श्रम्
with आ), a hermitage, the abode of ascetics, the
cell of a hermit or of retired saints or sages; a period
in the religious life of a Brāhman, of which there are
four referable to the different periods of life (viz. 1st,
that of the Brahma-cārin or student; 2nd, that of the
Gṛha-stha or householder; 3rd, that of the Vāna-
prastha or anchorite; and 4th, that of the Bhikṣu or
beggar: in some places the law-givers mention only
three such periods of religious life, the first period
being then omitted); a college, a school; a wood or
thicket.
—आश्रम-गुरु, उस्, m. the head of a re-
ligious order, a preceptor, a principal.
—आश्रम-
धर्म, अस्, m. the special duty or duties of each
order or period of life.
—आश्रम-पद, अम्, n. a
hermitage; a period in the religious life of a Brāhman.
—आश्रम-पर्वन्, अ, n. the first section of the fif-
teenth book of the Mahā-bhārata.
—आश्रम-भ्र-
ष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen or apostatising from an आश्रम
or religious order.
—आश्रम-मण्डल, अम्, n. the
circle of a hermitage, a hermitage.
—आश्रमवासिक,
अस्, ई, अम्, relating to residence in a hermitage;
आश्रमवासिकम् पर्व, title of the fifteenth book of
the Mahā-bhārata.
—आश्रम-वासिन्, ई, or आश्रम-
सद्, त्, m. an inhabitant of a hermitage, an ascetic.
—आश्रम-स्थान, अम्, n. the abode of hermits, a
hermitage.
—आश्रमालय (˚म-आल्˚), अस्, m. an in-
habitant of a hermitage, an ascetic.
—आश्रमोपनि-
षद् (˚म-उप्˚), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

अ-श्रमण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. indefatigable; (अस्),
m. one who is not an ascetic or Buddhist mendicant.

अ-श्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, untired, unwearied, eternal,
continual; (अम्), ind. unweariedly, continually, unin-
terruptedly.

अश्रवण अ-श्रवण, अम्, n. (rt. श्रु), loss of
hearing, deafness.

आ-श्रावण, अम्, n. calling out so as to make one
listen; designation of certain short words uttered at
ceremonies.

अ-श्राव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be heard, unfit to be
heard, not to be spoken of.
आ-श्राव्य, अस्, m., N. of a man.

अश्रातस् अ-श्रातस्, ind. (rt. श्रा), Ved. in
an uncooked manner, raw.

अश्रि अश्रि, इस्, or अश्री, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्?),
the sharp side of anything, a corner, angle of a room
or house; the edge of a sword [cf. Lat. acies, acer;
Lith. assmu˚].
—अश्रि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, cornered.

अस्रि अस्रि, इस्, f. an angle; ten millions.
See अश्रि.

आश्रि 1. आ-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to resort to, betake one's self to; seek refuge
in, enter, inhabit; depend on, choose, prefer; to
assist, adhere to, be subject to, keep in mind.

आश्रि 2. आश्रि, इस्, f. the edge of a sword.
See अश्रि.

अश्रित अ-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. unap-
proached, difficult of access; not stopping (?).

अश्रीक अ-श्रीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. श्री, q. v.),
unlucky, unpropitious.
अ-श्रीमत्, आन्, अती, अत्, unfortunate, inglorious.
अ-श्रीर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. unpleasant, ugly.
अ-श्रील, अस्, आ, अम्, unprosperous, unlucky.

अश्रु अश्रु, उ, n. a tear [supposed to stand
for दश्रु fr. rt. दंश्; cf. Gr. δάκρυ Lat. lacryma
for dacryma; Goth. tagrs, Them. tagra; Eng. tear;
Mod. Germ. Zähre; Lith. aszara].
—अश्रु-कला,
f. a tear-drop.
—अश्रु-नाली, f. Fistula Lachrymalis.
—अश्रु-परिपूर्णाक्ष(˚ण-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, whose
eyes are filled with tears.
—अश्रु-परिप्लुत, अस्, आ,
अम्, bathed in tears.
—अश्रु-पात, अस्, m. flow of
tears.
—अश्रु-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with tears.
—अश्रु-पूर्णाकुल (˚ण-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, troubled
and filled with tears.
—अश्रु-पूर्णाक्ष(˚ण-अक्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, whose eyes are filled with tears.
—अश्रु-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having tears on the face.
—अश्रु-
लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having tears in the eyes.
—अश्रू-
पहत (˚रु-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, affected by tears.
अस्रु अस्रु, n. a tear, &c. See अश्रु.

आश्रु आ-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रोतुम्, to
listen to, to hear; to accept, promise: Caus. -श्राव-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to hear, to call, to tell: Desid.
-शुश्रूषति, to wish to hear; to listen.

अश्रुत अ-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. श्रु), unheard,
inaudible; contrary to the Vedas; (अस्), m., N. of a
son of Kṛṣṇa, also of Dyutimat.
—अश्रुत-वत्, ind.
as if it were not heard.
—अश्रुत-व्रण, अस्, m., N.
of a man.

आ-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard, promised, agreed; (अम्),
n. calling so as to make one listen.

अ-श्रुति, इस्, f. not hearing, forgetfulness; not being
directed by the Vedas.
—अ-श्रुति-धर, अस्, आ, अम्,
not striking the hearing; not knowing the Veda.
आ-श्रुति, इस्, f., Ved. hearing; range of hearing.

अ-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not the best, inferior,
worse; bad, vile.

अश्रेष्मन् अ-श्रेष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. without
bands (?).

अश्रोत्रिय अ-श्रोत्रिय, अस्, m. a Brāhman
who has not read the Vedas; not a theologian.

अस्रवत् अ-स्रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (rt. स्रु), not
flowing; Ved. not leaky (as a ship).
अ-स्रुव, अम्, n. granulation (of a running sore).

अस्रिध् अ-स्रिध्, त्, त्, त्, or अ-स्रिधान, अस्, आ,
अम्, or अ-स्रेधत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. not doing
harm; uninjured, unfatigued; pious, peaceable.

अस्रीवयस् अस्री-वयस्, Ved. having food
which falls or drops down (?).

अस्रेमन् अस्रेमन्, आ, m., Ved. praiseworthy,
to be praised; (if fr. rt. स्रिव्) undecaying, immortal.

आश्रपण आ-श्रपण, अम्, n. (rt. श्री with आ),
the act of cooking slightly.

आश्रमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or आश्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
belonging to one of the four orders or periods of
religious life; belonging to a hermitage, a hermit,
an anchorite, &c.

आश्रव 1. आ-श्रव, अस्, m. (more correctly
written आ-स्रव, q. v.), stream, flow, river; distress,
fatigue; fault, transgression. (For 2. आ-श्रव see
under आ-श्रु next page.)

2. आ-श्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, obedient, compliant; (अस्),
m. a promise, an engagement. (For 1. आ-श्रव see
last page.)

आस्रव आ-स्रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रु with
prep. आ), the foam on boiling rice; flowing, running,
discharge; distress, pain, affliction; (with Jainas) that
which directs the embodied spirit towards eternal
objects, (viz. the occupation or employment of the
senses or organs on sensible objects; or the association
or connection of body with right and wrong deeds.)

आ-स्राव, अस्, m. flow, issue, running, discharge;
pain, affliction; a disease of the body.
—आस्राव-
भेषज, अम्, n., Ved. a medicament, medicine.

आ-श्रयण, अस्, ई, अम्, resorting to, seeking refuge
in; relating to; (अम्), n. betaking one's self to;
joining, accepting, choosing; refuge, asylum, means
of protection or security.

आ-श्रयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be had recourse to,
to be practised or followed.

आ-श्रित्य, ind. having sought or obtained an asylum;
having recourse to, employing, practising.

आश्रुत्-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. one whose ears
listen all around.

आ-श्रेष, अस्, m. (for आ-श्लेष), Ved. one who
embraces; N. of an evil spirit or goblin; (आस्), f. pl.,
N. of the seventh Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.

आस्रप आस्रप, अस्, m. (fr. अस्र-प), the
nineteenth lunar mansion.

आस्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing, emitting fluid, dis-
charging humor; an epithet of the elephant (a fluid
issuing from its temples during the rutting-time).

आस्रस्त आ-स्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen off,
loose.
